subparts.stem: In the expansion of $(2x + k)^7$, $k > 0$, the coefficient of $x^3$ is 10 times the coefficient of $x$. Find the value of $k$.

Setting up the relation: coefficient of $x^3 = 10 \times$ coefficient of $x$

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Equate the terms from the binomial expansion $(2+kx)^7$ using the given proportional relation.
step_by_step: Coefficient of $x^3$ is $\binom{7}{3} 2^{7-3} k^3$ or equivalent depending on definition.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Forgetting to exclude the negative square root when $k > 0$ is specified.
